question: How to Take a Screenshot on Windows 11?
short_desc: Learn the fastest ways to capture your screen on Windows 11 using keyboard shortcuts and built-in tools.
content:
Taking a screenshot on Windows 11 is very easy. Here are the top 3 methods:

Method 1: Using Snipping Tool

Press Windows + Shift + S. Your screen will dim, and you can drag to select the area you want to capture. It will be copied to your clipboard.

Method 2: Print Screen Key

Press the PrtScn button. This copies the entire screen to your clipboard.

Method 3: Game Bar

Press Windows + G to open the Game Bar, then click the camera icon to take a screenshot.

question: What is My IP Address and How to Check It?
short_desc: Understand what an IP address is and find out how you can check your public IP address instantly.
content:
An IP (Internet Protocol) address is a unique string of numbers separated by periods that identifies each computer using the Internet Protocol to communicate over a network.

How to check your IP?

You can simply Google the word 'What is my IP' and Google will show it at the top. Alternatively, you can visit websites like whatismyip.com.

Why hide your IP?

If you want to protect your privacy, you can use a VPN (Virtual Private Network) to mask your real IP address.
